notes.title: Demo Patch 0.2
notes.content:
\[Patch Notes] Major Updates
Train Mode Added: You can now test your skills freely before entering battle.

New Maps: New environments have been added for more diverse gameplay.

Round Clear Feedback Improved: Enhanced feedback and effects upon clearing a round.

Camera Improvements:

Adjusted camera height for better visibility.

Reduced jitter issues occurring in specific situations.

Skill Visuals Enhanced: Improved visual clarity for level 2 and level 3 skills.

UI Visuals Improved: Enhanced UI elements for better readability and immersion.

Fixed Skill Effect Sound Bugs: Resolved an issue where some skill sounds wouldn’t play properly.

Character HP Bar Improved: Improved design and visibility of the health bar for clearer combat feedback.

Sound Improvements:

Added new footstep sounds for the character.

Improved dash sound for smoother audio feedback.

notes.title: Demo Patch 0.1.1
notes.content:
Improved the tutorial experience.

Added new tutorial steps.

Enhanced the hit feedback effects for the player character.

Increased the size of enemy projectiles.

Updated the visual effect for the Darkness 5-synergy.

Modified the flow so that after winning a round, there is a brief pause before proceeding to the next round.

Reduced jittering issues.

notes.title: Demo Patch 0.1
notes.content:
\[Notice]
We are currently improving the patching system. As a result, patch sizes may be temporarily larger than usual.
[hr][/hr] \[New Features]
Added multilingual support for tooltips.

Introduced a new tutorial to enhance player understanding of the game.
[hr][/hr] \[UI & Font Improvements]
Updated the in-game font used across the UI.

Skill effects now become more transparent when multiple skills are activated simultaneously.
[hr][/hr] \[Bug Fixes]
Fixed an issue where the electric attribute's stagger effect was not working properly.

Fixed an issue where an excessive number of "0" damage texts appeared when the 5-stack synergy of the electric attribute was triggered.

Fixed a bug that prevented key settings from being changed after returning from the lobby.

Mitigated an issue where some skill sounds failed to play when multiple sounds were triggered at once.
[hr][/hr] \[Balance & System Changes]
Buffed the special effect of the darkness attribute.

Removed the basic attack feature.

Reorganized the default key settings for skills.

notes.title: Hotfix 0.2
notes.content:
\[Balance Adjustments]

Reduced the number of summoned bosses, while slightly increasing their individual combat strength.

\[UI Improvements]

Added visual feedback elements to the main lobby and stage UI to enhance clarity and user experience.

\[Other Improvements]

Improved overall game stability to reduce unexpected crashes in certain environments.

notes.title: Hotfix 0.1
notes.content:
\[Bug Fixes]

Fixed an issue where some bosses would not attack.

Fixed an issue where certain tornado effects appeared excessively large.

Fixed an issue where the enemy trait selection text was not displaying correctly.
